title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Custom Report Layouts are now deprecated and have been removed
summary: Custom Report Layouts have been removed in Business Central 2026 wave 2 (BC29). Organizations must migrate all custom layouts to the new Report Layouts feature before upgrading, as the legacy Custom Report Layouts page is no longer accessible.
key_points: Custom Report Layouts page has been completely removed in BC29 and is no longer accessible
This legacy feature from Dynamics NAV was already obsolete but retained through BC28.5
Users should migrate existing custom layouts (Word and RDLC types) to the new user-defined Report Layouts feature
Migration to Report Layouts must be completed before upgrading to BC29

quotes.text: Microsoft has completely removed this page in Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29), and it is no longer accessible.
quotes.why_it_matters: Signals a breaking change requiring immediate action from users still using the legacy Custom Report Layouts feature

quotes.text: Please ensure that all Custom Report Layouts are fully migrated to Report Layouts before upgrading to Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29).
quotes.why_it_matters: Direct guidance on the upgrade prerequisite to avoid broken functionality
